entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. I received it about a month ago, right when it launched.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up your order information... One moment... Okay, I see the order from December 15th. You'd like to start a return for that?
Yes, please. It's just not quite for me, if that makes sense.

Oh, that is absolutely **no problem** at all. According to our policy here, you have **90 days** from the delivery date for a full refund, so you're well within the window. We can definitely get that processed.
Oh, wonderful! That's great to hear. I was a little worried.

Not at all! And I see here that you're a VIP customer with us. Thank you for your loyalty! I've just sent a prepaid **return label** to the email on file. As an extra thank you, I've also added a credit for free two-day shipping on your next purchase.
Wow, that's really generous. Thank you so much, Judy. That was incredibly easy.
It's my pleasure! Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a fantastic day!
